decisions.D01: Each completed arrow tower costs 0.1 gold per combat second, including idle time.
decisions.D02: No debt. All towers share available power equally; time paid for determines their firing-clock advance. Income restores power automatically. Purchased towers at zero gold warn clearly.
decisions.D03: Mine income runs during the 60-second spawning phase only, preventing clearance farming. Tower upkeep continues through clearance. All gameplay clocks stop while paused.
decisions.D04: Tower build 3 seconds; mine build 4 seconds. Released progress decays by 0.25 normalized units/second, immediately.
decisions.D05/D17: Floating-point ledger, 2 decimal HUD display; income then upkeep then construction then settlement. Clamp tiny numerical noise only. Work requires affordability to advance; when unaffordable it decays. Purchase rechecks and charges once at completion.
decisions.D06: One nearest eligible target within 3.5m horizontally of its front interaction pad, within 3m vertically, facing within 75 degrees; clear line of sight to the pad. Construction works in setup/spawning/clearance. Each site can retain independent partial progress; all unattended sites decay. Death/movement/switch cancel active work and require B release before resuming; pause freezes; retry clears. Holding B suppresses attack inputs while working.
decisions.D07: Hold Y 3 seconds in setup, release decay 1/3 per second. Living hero required. Pause freezes. Opening a menu/switch/death resets confirmation and requires release. Every setup rearms only after Y release; no carried held key starts the next wave.
decisions.D08: 300 actors at times 0.2,0.4,...,60.0 each wave. Mode cap 300, independent of prototype cap setting; no backlog or skipped demand. A delayed tick emits all demand due through 60.0, then enters clearance; it never schedules later demand.
decisions.D09/D12: Three existing normal visual variants with 100 HP, no armor/role mitigation, no HP growth and no bosses in this MVP. Existing hero combat/progression remains intact.
decisions.D10: A base breach costs 1 integrity and removes/resolves that actor. Clearance means no living/unresolved actors; killed + breached = spawned. Breaches never award kill credit.
decisions.D11: Arrow range 48m, priority furthest downstream then nearest; instant eligible first shot, 0.5s cadence, 50 damage at impact. Visible arrow travels at 65m/s toward its committed target, stops on world obstruction, expires if target dies or generation changes. No retarget burst and no setup shots.
decisions.D13: Enemy route speed is 1.35x while the hero is dead, resets on revival, never stacks.
decisions.D14: Auto revive after 5 active seconds at the original spawn, full HP and 2 seconds immunity. Preserve progression; cancel active attacks/abilities/projectiles on death. No movement/attacks/build/start/switch while dead. Camera stays available through right-drag while the cursor can click Revive Now. Beta has Revive Now; Hard uses timer only.
decisions.D15: No mine upgrades, cannon progression, ammo, replacement cards, or undefined purchases.
decisions.D16: Exactly four front-wall sites plus two straight rows of four approach sites. No rear build sites. Mine to base left; interaction pads preserve the open route. Structures are immune scenery; their pads do not block the route.
decisions.D18: Economy/wave HUD upper left, build/status panel upper right, current portrait/HP/LMB/RMB bottom center; existing remaining abilities still accessible. Distinct primary/secondary placeholders allowed.
decisions.D19: Beta and Hard remain exposed with 100/50 integrity. Existing allied roster, limits and purchase costs are retained for MVP; enemies cannot target or damage allies. They award no kill gold/items.
decisions.D20: Base failure takes precedence. Settlement runs only with positive integrity; final 100 gold is credited before victory UI. Hero death cannot block victory. Terminal/reset retires projectiles, build input and revival.
